summary: Hut 8 Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a press release regarding the commercialization of the second phase of its Beacon Point data center campus through a 15-year lease for 352 MW of IT capacity, doubling total contracted capacity to 704 MW. The lease is triple net, with a high-investment-grade tenant and $9.8 billion base-term contract value. No price per share, stakeholder, or merger terms are provided. This is a routine operational update on a lease agreement, not a special situation event.
